cohort: 504 women who delivered at Soroka University Medical Center between 1988-2013. The cohort was divided into two groups: women with endometriosis (N=35) and women without endometriosis (N=467).
finding: While women with endometriosis had significantly higher rates of cesarean sections, endometriosis was not found to be a risk factor for obstetrical complications or adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with endometriosis had significantly higher rates of cesarean sections.
